name: UAV-Need-Help
description: UAV-Need-Help is an assistant-guided UAV object search benchmark providing varying levels of guidance information to help UAVs accomplish realistic vision-language navigation tasks in complex aerial environments.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark from a recent UAV vision-language navigation paper, with limited broad community adoption compared with major navigation benchmarks.
notes: Includes a new UAV VLN dataset with ~12k trajectories and a platform for realistic UAV trajectory simulation.
